guides.title: Birth, marriage, and death certificates
guides.scope: Provincial information or national service available to Siquijor residents
guides.content:
# Birth, marriage, and death certificates

Request a PSA birth, marriage, or death certificate. Find the details to prepare, application steps, delivery options, and fees below.

## Which information should you prepare?

Have the following record details ready before starting your request. Identity and authorization checks apply when the certificate is released.

### Birth certificate

- Child’s full name, including middle name.
- Father’s full name and mother’s full maiden name.
- Birth date and municipality/city and province of birth.
- Whether registration was late and, if so, the year it was registered.
- Requester’s full name, address, and relationship to the child.
- Number of copies and the reason for the request. [1]

### Marriage certificate

Prepare both spouses’ full names, the marriage date and place, your own full name and address, the quantity needed, and the request’s purpose. [2]

### Death certificate

Prepare the deceased person’s full name, date and place of death, your own complete name and address, the quantity needed, and the request’s purpose. The national page additionally lists the place of marriage among its death-request fields; use the actual issuing channel’s form to establish whether that field applies. [3]

## How to request a certificate

1. Identify the certificate and gather its record details above.
2. Choose an **in-person PSA outlet request** or an **online delivery request**. PSA’s birth-certificate page says an appointment is required for walk-in requests. Its linked appointment service is `appointment.psa.gov.ph`. PSA identifies **PSA Serbilis** and **PSAHelpline** as online channels. [1]
3. Give your real requester and record details to the chosen official channel. Birth records have restricted release; the PSA page lists the record owner, authorized persons, and specified relatives or legal representatives among those who may request them. [1]
4. Follow that channel’s identity/authorization checks and retain its reference or receipt. For an outlet transaction, follow the release instruction on your receipt rather than assume same-day release.

For online submission, PSA’s listed channels are [PSA Serbilis](https://www.psaserbilis.com.ph/) and [PSAHelpline](https://psahelpline.ph/).

## PSA Serbilis fees for Philippine delivery and related channels

The provider’s published FAQ lists these charges. The figures are for **PSA Serbilis**, not a universal PSA outlet or PSAHelpline price. The FAQ is undated; the figures below were checked on **17 November 2026**. [4]

| Receiving option | Birth, marriage, or death | CENOMAR or CENODEATH |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First copy: Philippine door delivery, LBC pickup, or embassy delivery | ₱330 | ₱430 |
| Each additional copy under its published tiered-pricing example | ₱280 | ₱380 |
| Government-agency E-Copy | ₱300 | ₱360 |
| Viewable Online | ₱130 | ₱185 |

**Viewable Online** is paid at a PSA CRS outlet for identity verification and an access code. Its optional **DocPrint** paper copy is **₱80 per copy**, requested within the online document’s **60-day** validity. Government-agency E-Copy and Viewable Online are separate receiving options; they are not the same as paper courier delivery. [4]

## Delivery to Siquijor

Siquijor falls under the provider’s **Other Provinces** destination category. Its delivery page estimates **6–8 working days** for that category, with **5–7 additional days** outside the courier’s standard service areas. It asks customers to allow **10–15 additional working days** for requests requiring manual PSA searching. Flight unavailability or cancellation can alter the schedule. These are provider estimates, not a fixed Siquijor island delivery guarantee. [5]

The request’s receiving option and address determine the total shown before payment. A certificate order is a different transaction from a correction, late registration, or marriage-license application at the relevant civil registrar.

## Sources and dates

1. [PSA — Birth Certificate (undated service page)](https://psa.gov.ph/birth-certificate)
2. [PSA — Marriage Certificate (undated service page)](https://psa.gov.ph/marriage-certificate)
3. [PSA — Death Certificate (undated service page)](https://psa.gov.ph/death-certificate)
4. [PSA Serbilis — Frequently Asked Questions, Payment and Viewable Online sections (undated)](https://www.psaserbilis.com.ph/GetFaQs)
5. [PSA Serbilis — Delivery schedule (undated)](https://psaserbilis.com.ph/Delivery)

Source review: **17 November 2026**. Source editions and publication dates are identified above.

guides.title: National ID registration and Digital National ID
guides.scope: Provincial information or national service available to Siquijor residents
guides.content:
# National ID registration and Digital National ID

Register for your National ID or download a Digital National ID if you are already registered. Find the steps and fee information below.

## If you are already registered with PhilSys

To access your Digital National ID: [1]

1. Use a computer or smartphone with internet and a camera for the facial verification step.
2. Open the official Digital National ID service at `national-id.gov.ph`.
3. Choose **Proceed** and review the consent for using identity information and the facial image to authenticate you.
4. Enter your first, middle, and last names and date of birth, then continue.
5. Start the **liveness** check and follow the facial-verification instructions.
6. After successful verification, display your National ID and use the download option to retain a personal copy.

You must already be registered with PhilSys to retrieve a Digital National ID. Follow the on-screen instructions to complete identity verification.

## Fees and timing

**Assisted Digital National ID generation is free.** The **2025 PSA charter** sets a **seven-minute** service standard, subject to internet connectivity. Allow time for queuing and identity verification. First-time registration and plastic-card delivery follow separate processes. [2]

## If you have never registered

PSA’s registration notice says its old online Step 1 registration service is disabled and applicants may register in person at a PhilSys registration center with supporting documents. [3] A Digital National ID download cannot substitute for that registration.

Bring your supporting identity documents to a PhilSys registration center. Contact PSA before travelling to check the center’s schedule and documents for your circumstances.

## Access your Digital National ID

[Digital National ID access](https://national-id.gov.ph/) is the official retrieval service. BetterSiquijor does not ask for your date of birth, take your photo, or run the biometric check.

## Sources and dates

1. [PSA RSSO VIII — Digital National ID instructions, 9 August 2024](https://rsso08.psa.gov.ph/content/digital-national-id-now-downloadable-all-filipinos-registered-philsys)
2. [PSA — 2025 Citizen’s Charter, PhilSys Registry Office external services](https://psa.gov.ph/system/files/citizens-charter/5-PSA-2025-Citizens-Charter-Philippine-Identification-System-Registry%20Office-External-Services.pdf)
3. [PSA — PhilSys registration notice](https://maintenance.register.philsys.gov.ph/)

Source review: **17 November 2026**. Source editions and publication dates are identified above.

guides.title: PhilHealth registration and member services
guides.scope: Provincial information or national service available to Siquijor residents
guides.content:
# PhilHealth registration and member services

Register with PhilHealth, access your Member Data Record, or manage your membership online. Find the steps and Siquijor office contact below.

## Choose the transaction that matches your situation

| Situation | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| Employed, no PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN) yet | Complete two PMRF copies and submit them to your employer’s HR unit; await the Member Data Record (MDR) and ID through the employer. [1] |
| Newly hired, already has a PIN | Give the existing PIN to the employer for employee reporting. [1] |
| Applying under PhilHealth’s informal-economy procedure | Submit two completed PMRF copies to a Local Health Insurance Office or PhilHealth Express and await the MDR and ID. The published procedure also covers payment using the assigned number. [2] |
| Already registered and needs records online | Create or use a Member Portal account. [3–4] |

Use your existing PIN if you already have one. Choose the procedure that matches your membership category.

## Existing-member portal: what to prepare

The account-creation screen asks for a **PIN, names, birth date, sex, email address, mobile number, and a chosen password**. It provides a mononym option. The password requirements shown are **8–32 characters**, with a digit, upper- and lowercase letters, and a special character. Complete its CAPTCHA and account-creation action. [4]

For later login, the portal requests the PIN, password, and CAPTCHA. A password-reset request asks for the **PIN and email address** and sends a reset link. [5]

PhilHealth lists online access to contribution records and the MDR, premium payment, and YAKAP clinic selection among member services. Those functions do not themselves determine a particular patient’s benefit entitlement. [3]

## Visit or contact PhilHealth Siquijor

**Ground Floor, Multi-Purpose Center, Poblacion, Siquijor 6225, Siquijor**. Contact: **(035) 480-9844**, **0975 241 6827**, **satelliteofficesiquijor.pro7@philhealth.gov.ph**. [6]

## Manage your membership

Use the agency’s [Member Portal](https://memberinquiry.philhealth.gov.ph/member/) for an online transaction or the proper employer/PhilHealth office for registration. Submit membership details and payments directly to PhilHealth or your employer, as applicable.

## Sources and dates

1. [PhilHealth — Formal Economy Registration Procedures](https://www.philhealth.gov.ph/members/formal/registration.php)
2. [PhilHealth — Informal Economy Registration Procedures](https://www.philhealth.gov.ph/members/informal/registration.php)
3. [PhilHealth — Online Services](https://www.philhealth.gov.ph/services/)
4. [PhilHealth — Member Portal Account Creation](https://memberinquiry.philhealth.gov.ph/member/accountCreation.xhtml)
5. [PhilHealth — Password Reset](https://memberinquiry.philhealth.gov.ph/member/forgotPassword.xhtml)
6. [PhilHealth — Regional Offices Directory, Siquijor entry](https://www.philhealth.gov.ph/about_us/directory/)

guides.title: Basic education enrollment in Siquijor
guides.scope: Provincial information or national service available to Siquijor residents
guides.content:
# Basic education enrollment in Siquijor

Enroll a learner in basic education. Prepare the enrollment form and supporting documents, then submit them to the learner’s school.

[Find a school near you](/services/education/find-school).

## Who handles enrollment?

The learner’s school receives the enrollment documents. The Schools Division of Siquijor’s published office is **Helen, Larena, Siquijor**; its email is **deped.siquijor@deped.gov.ph** and published mobile is **0906 432 9162**. [1]

## How to enroll

DepEd’s **13 June 2025 Revised Basic Education Enrollment Policy** and its following-day public explainer describe these arrangements: [2–3]

1. Complete the **Basic Education Enrollment Form (BEEF)** and submit it with the applicable supporting documents to the school.
2. For a minor, the enrollment form is signed by a parent or legal guardian; an adult learner may submit their own enrollment.
3. The policy calls for the original or certified true copy of a PSA/NSO birth certificate, submitted **once across K–12**. Where it is unavailable, the published policy allows specified secondary documents, including a National ID, local certificate of live birth, barangay certification, or a parent-signed undertaking. The **2025 explainer** refers to **31 October** for temporary secondary-document acceptance; this guide does not present that as a new 2026 deadline.
4. Enrollment can be conducted in person or using the school’s designated remote submission arrangements, such as email, messaging, or a drop box.
5. For a transfer, school records are transmitted **school to school** rather than treated as a new parent-printed requirement.

## Fees and school-year dates

The **2025 DepEd explainer** states that voluntary fees are not collected during early registration and enrollment. This is not a claim that every school-related purchase or private-school tuition is free.

## Before you contact the school

Have the learner’s name, grade level, existing Learner Reference Number if applicable, and school ready when you ask about enrollment. Ask the school to identify its currently accepted submission method before sending personal documents.

## Sources and dates

1. [Schools Division of Siquijor — Division Office](https://www.deped-siquijor.com/districts/)
2. [DepEd Order 017, s. 2025 — Revised Basic Education Enrollment Policy, 13 June 2025](https://www.deped.gov.ph/2025/06/13/june-13-2025-do-017-s-2025-revised-basic-education-enrollment-policy/)
3. [DepEd — Revised enrollment policy explainer, 14 June 2025](https://www.deped.gov.ph/2025/06/14/deped-may-mas-pinadali-at-mas-abot-kayang-enrollment-sa-ilalim-ng-pbbm-admin/)

Source review: **17 November 2026**. Source editions and publication dates are identified above.

guides.title: Request school records
guides.scope: Provincial information or national service available to Siquijor residents
guides.content:
# Request school records

Get a School Form 9, Good Moral Certificate, or Certificate of Enrollment from the learner’s school. Requirements and service standards below follow **DepEd’s 2026 Citizen’s Charter, 2nd Edition**. [1]

[Find your school’s location and contact details](/services/education/find-school).

## Documents to bring

- A request letter signed by the parent or guardian, stating the learner’s SF9 request: **one original and one photocopy**.
- A government-issued valid ID: **one original and one photocopy**.
- If using an authorized representative: **one original authorization letter** and **one photocopy of the requesting person’s government-issued valid ID**.

Examples of IDs listed in the charter include PhilSys ID/ePhilID, Philippine passport, driver’s license, PRC ID, UMID, voter’s ID, senior citizen ID, postal ID, PhilHealth ID, and barangay ID. [1]

## How to request

1. Submit the required documents to the school registrar or records custodian.
2. The school checks the request, verifies the record, and prepares the document for signature.
3. Wait for the school’s release notice.
4. Claim your document and sign the school’s release log.

## Fees and processing time

| Document | Fee | Charter service standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| School Form 9 | None | 59 minutes |
| Good Moral Certificate or Certificate of Enrollment | None | 54 minutes |

These are the charter’s processing standards for the specified services. Ask the school about the availability of the learner’s record and collection arrangements. [1]

## Academic records for local employment

Past learners requesting certified SF9 or SF10 for local employment should bring **one original request letter** and a **government-issued valid ID, original plus one photocopy**. An authorized representative also needs an original authorization letter and a photocopy of the requesting person’s government-issued valid ID. The charter lists **no fee** and a **3-hour, 59-minute** service standard. [1]

## Contact the Schools Division

**Helen, Larena, Siquijor**  
**0906 432 9162**  
**deped.siquijor@deped.gov.ph** [2]

For enrollment, see [Enroll in basic education](/services/education/schools-division).

[Download DepEd’s 2026 charter (PDF, approximately 10 MB)](/documents/deped-citizens-charter-2026-2nd-edition.pdf).

## Sources and dates

1. [DepEd — Citizen’s Charter 2026 (2nd Edition), pages 531–532 and 540–543](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/DepEd-Citizens-Charter-2026-2nd-Edition.pdf)
2. [Schools Division of Siquijor — Division Office](https://www.deped-siquijor.com/districts/)
3. [Schools Division of Siquijor — Districts and Schools](https://www.deped-siquijor.com/schools-2/)

# Public higher education in Siquijor

Explore courses at **Siquijor State College in Larena**. Compare programs in education, business, technology, maritime studies, and other fields.

[Find all colleges in Siquijor, campus contacts, and private college courses](/services/education/colleges).

## Institution and location

Siquijor State College is in **Larena, Siquijor**. Contact the college at **presoffice@siquijorstate.edu.ph** for help reaching the appropriate office.

## Courses and programs

Choose an academic area to explore the college’s program offerings. Ask the college about available intakes and admission requirements for your chosen course. [2]

| Academic unit | Programs |
| --- | --- |
| Criminal Justice Education | Criminology bachelor’s program |
| Arts and Sciences | English Language; Filipino; Development Communication; Political Science |
| Business and Management | Public Management master’s; Business Administration bachelor’s with General Management, Human Resource Management, or Marketing; Hospitality Management; Tourism Management |
| Education | Educational Management master’s; Elementary Education; Secondary Education with English, Mathematics, or Filipino |
| Technology | Industrial Education master’s; Industrial Technology with Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, or Automotive Technology; Information Technology |
| Maritime Education | Marine Transportation; Marine Engineering; enhanced support-level programs for deck and marine engineering |

The same catalogue lists **ABM, GAS, and Maritime senior-high strands**, plus junior high school.

## Choosing a program

Choose your course and specialization, then ask the college about application dates, entrance assessments, and the documents required for admission.

## Sources and dates

1. [Central Mindanao University — Admission test pilot at SSC, August 2026](https://www.cmu.edu.ph/cmu-conducts-pilot-testing-of-updated-admission-test-at-siquijor-state-college/)
2. [Siquijor State College — Published Program Offerings](https://siquijorstate.edu.ph/programs-offered/)

**Telephone: 0935 055 9866.** [1–2]

- Places to stay and restaurants.
- Transport and inbound tour operators.

guides.title: Siquijor destination guide
guides.scope: Provincial information or national service available to Siquijor residents
guides.content:
# Siquijor destination guide

Discover Siquijor’s waterfalls, heritage, and local traditions. Explore places to visit and find help planning your trip.

## Explore the island

Siquijor is part of the **Negros Island Region**. The Department of Tourism calls it the **Healing Island**, a name associated with its cultural traditions. [1]

| Place or event | What to explore |
| --- | --- |
| Cambugahay Falls | A three-tier waterfall with turquoise pools and cascades |
| Lazi Convent | A Bahay na Bato structure completed in 1891 and home to the Siquijor Heritage Museum |
| Balay Pahiuli | Local traditional rituals and massage practices |
| Healing Festival | A Holy Week celebration at Mount Bandilaan Nature Park, with traditional knowledge, herbs, crafts, and local products |

## Getting to Siquijor

A ferry route linking **Lazi, Tagbilaran City, and Plaridel in Misamis Occidental** began commercial service on **23 October 2026**, according to the Philippine Information Agency. [2] Check your operator’s sailing schedule and fare before booking.

## Help planning your visit

Contact the **Provincial Tourism Office: 0935 055 9866** for visitor information. [3] Have your travel dates, destination, transport questions, and any accessibility needs ready.

See [Tourism Office services](/services/tourism/provincial-tourism-office) for more ways to plan your trip.

## Sources and dates

Tourism office contact listings are undated and were reviewed on 17 November 2026. Telephone operation was not tested. Destination descriptions do not establish current opening hours, prices, accreditation, or treatment effectiveness. The ferry announcement records a launch, not a live timetable.

1. [Department of Tourism — Siquijor destination profile](https://www.tourism.gov.ph/destination/nir/siquijor/)
2. [Philippine Information Agency — New Lazi ferry route, 29 October 2026](https://pia.gov.ph/news/new-ferry-route-links-siquijor-bohol-misamis-occidental/)
